extracted.geometry_description: The design domain is the annular cross-section of a chilled-jacket pipe, D = { x : r0 < |x| < R } with outer radius R = 0.5 m (a pipe of diameter 1 m) and initial inner radius r0 = 0.1 m. The OUTER circle Gamma_o is a fixed boundary; the INNER circle Gamma_i is a design boundary.

designed.domain_description: Annular cross-section of a chilled-jacket pipe: the disk of outer radius R = 0.5 m (diameter 1 m) minus a concentric circular hole of initial radius r0 = 0.1 m. The outer circle (label 3) is the fixed Robin casing boundary and the inner circle (label 2) is the design boundary / refrigerant wall.
